paymentGuide.unusedPaid: You can request a refund for unused paid points within 7 days of buying them.
paymentGuide.spent: Points you've used and accessories or mascots bought with points can't be refunded.
paymentGuide.setUnworn: You can request a refund for a set within 7 days of payment if you haven't worn it.
paymentGuide.setWorn: Once you wear a set, it can't be refunded.
paymentGuide.deleteAccount: After 7 days, if you delete your account, we refund your remaining paid points minus a 10% fee.
paymentGuide.storeRefund: If the store (App Store or Google Play) issues a refund, we take back the same amount of points.
paymentGuide.negative: If you've already used those points, your balance can go below 0.
paymentGuide.minor: If a minor paid without a legal guardian's consent, the minor or the guardian can cancel the payment.
